title: MCP servers
description: On {{computer}}, command servers run locally; address servers receive tool calls.
place.noFolders: No folder listed yet: choose Another folder… to enter one.
place.noFolder: Pick or enter a folder to see its servers.
open.failed: The settings chat could not be opened
open.failed.not_ready: The agent on {{computer}} is not signed in as you, so no settings chat was opened.
open.failed.scope: This place cannot have a settings chat. Pick one realm and a folder path.
open.failed.unknown: The agent did not answer whether the settings chat was opened. If it was, it closes by itself. Try again.
open.failed.binding: The agent opened the settings chat somewhere else, so it was closed again.
open.failed.lease: The settings chat could not be kept open, so it was closed again.
open.failed.lost: The settings chat was lost twice in a row.
open.failed.other: The agent refused to open a settings chat.
open.failed.demo: This is the demo: nothing is changed, so no settings chat was opened.
lost: The settings chat was lost again right after it was replaced. Try again opens a new one.
loadFailed: The MCP servers could not be read
unreadable.title: The agent's answer could not be read as a whole
unreadable.body: Nothing is shown, so nothing can be changed by mistake.
col.name: Server
effect.runs: Starts {{command}} on {{computer}}, as you, when a chat starts
effect.sends: Sends your agents' tool calls to {{host}}
effect.unknown: The agent did not say what it runs or where it sends
readonly.none: Its settings file is not stated, so it cannot be changed here
actions.wait: Waits until the servers are read.
actions.busy: Waits for the change in progress.
actions.noScope: No settings file here can take a server.
empty.title: No MCP server here yet
facts.label: Where this list comes from
facts.from.realm: A settings chat for this realm on {{computer}}, with no tools
facts.from.folder: A settings chat in this folder on {{computer}}, with no tools
facts.open.value: While this page is open; closed when you leave
reconnect.done: The servers were reconnected. The list shows how each one is now.
reconnect.rate_limited: Reconnected a moment ago. Wait a little, then try again.
reconnect.pending: The agent did not answer the reconnect. The list shows how each server is now.
reconnect.partial: A settings file could not be read, so its servers were not reconnected. Fix the file the warnings name, then reconnect.
waiting: A change has no answer yet. Changes wait until it is no longer tracked: Check again only refreshes the servers, and Stop tracking ends the hold.
on.title: Turn on {{name}}?
on.note: It also starts in every chat open now.
off.done: Turned off. It is cut off in every open chat.
rm.title: Remove {{name}}?
rm.effect: Removes it from {{scope}}. It is cut off in every open chat now.
rm.effect2: Its saved values are deleted with it.
rm.effectSends: Your agents' tool calls no longer go to {{host}}.
save.note: It also starts in every chat open now.
save.cleared: Its saved values below are removed, because what it runs or where it sends changed.
saved: Saved. The list shows the server as the agent has it now.
held: The agent did not answer this change to {{scope}}. It may have gone through. Check again reads the servers only; nothing is sent again.
held.stopEffect: The page stops checking whether the change went through. It may still have been saved.
conflict: Changed on {{computer}} since you opened it. Nothing was saved.
conflict.gone: This server is no longer saved there.
refused.mcp_not_in_layer: This server is not in that settings file any more. Nothing was changed.
refused.bad_request: The agent refused this change. Nothing was changed.
refused.realm_denied: This realm is not available to the agent. Nothing was changed.
notsent.NONCE_UNREADABLE: The agent's permission for this change could not be read, so nothing was sent.
notsent.SETTINGS_SUPERSEDED: You left this place before the change was sent, so nothing was sent.
dlg.name: Name
dlg.nameHint: Letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Agents see its tools as name__tool.
dlg.commandHint: The program to start, for example npx.
dlg.urlHint: Where the server listens, starting with https://.
dlg.confirmCalls: Ask before every call from this server
dlg.repoint: Changing what it runs or where it sends removes saved values. Type any you still need again.
dlg.credInText: The address or the arguments look like they hold a password or a token. They are saved and shown as typed. Put secrets in environment values or headers instead.
problem.name.chars: Use letters, numbers, dashes and underscores only, at most 64, never two underscores in a row.
problem.name.reserved: hoody and mcp are reserved names.
problem.name.taken: A server with this name is already in the list.
problem.url: Type an address starting with http:// or https://.
problem.env_key: Environment names use letters, numbers and underscores, and do not start with a number.
problem.header_key: Header names use letters, numbers and dashes.
problem.header_reserved: The agent sets Accept, Content-Type, Last-Event-ID and every header starting with Mcp- itself. Remove that header.
problem.duplicate_key: Each name can be used once.
allRealms: Pick one realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square) to see its MCP servers.
noComputer: Pick a computer in the top bar to see its MCP servers.
dlg.envHint: Environment values: Values are saved on {{computer}} and never shown again, here or anywhere. To change one, type a new value.
dlg.headersHint: Headers: Values are saved on {{computer}} and never shown again, here or anywhere. To change one, type a new value.
unreadableRows: {{count}} servers in the agent’s list could not be read: {{names}}. They are not shown and cannot be changed here.
unreadableRows_one: {{count}} server in the agent’s list could not be read: {{names}}. It is not shown and cannot be changed here.
elsewhere.realm: A change to the realm’s MCP servers has no answer yet. Changes here wait until it is no longer tracked: go to it and choose Stop tracking.
elsewhere.folder: A change to the MCP servers of {{folder}} has no answer yet. Changes here wait until it is no longer tracked: go to it and choose Stop tracking.
conflict.before: Changed on {{computer}} while you were reviewing it, so nothing was sent.
reconnect.background: Reconnected. Other chats of this place are reconnecting in the background.
reconnect.skipped: Reconnected here, but other chats of this place were not reconnected: the agent was busy. Reconnect again in a moment.
conflict.unreadable: This server can no longer be read there, so it cannot be edited from here. Reload to see the list now.
conflict.otherLayer: This server is now saved in {{scope}}, not where you edited it. Reload, then edit it again.
notsent.LIST_UNREADABLE: The settings could not be read just before sending, so nothing was sent.
notsent.NOT_FOUND_UNREADABLE: The agent's answer could not be read, so nothing was sent.
notsent.LAYER_UNKNOWN: This settings file could not be read, so nothing was sent.
imp.title: Import MCP servers
imp.docHint: Paste an MCP config from Claude, Cursor, VS Code or Hoody. Its values stay in this box: the preview below shows their names only.
imp.problem.too_big: This config is larger than 1 MB. Import fewer servers at a time.
imp.stale: The config changed after its preview. Preview it again before you import it.
imp.refused: The agent refused this config: it is not an MCP config, or one of its servers lacks a valid name, a command or an address. Nothing was imported.
imp.unreadable: The agent's preview could not be read, so nothing of it is shown and nothing can be imported.
imp.failed: The preview could not be made
imp.empty: This config has no server to import.
imp.dialect.claude: Read as a Claude or Cursor config.
imp.dialect.vscode: Read as a VS Code config.
imp.dialect.bare: Read as a list of servers.
imp.overlap: Already listed from {{scope}}: {{names}}. Without Replace, the import is refused if any of them is saved there.
imp.replace: Replace servers with the same name
imp.confirm.title: Import {{count}} servers?
imp.effect.runs: {{name}}: would start {{command}} on {{computer}}, as you, once you turn it on
imp.effect.sends: {{name}}: would send your agents' tool calls to {{host}} once you turn it on
imp.effect.unknown: {{name}}: what it runs or where it sends could not be read
imp.effect.replaces: May replace {{name}} if it is saved in {{scope}}
imp.effect.off: Every server lands off: nothing starts and nothing is sent until you turn it on.
imp.done: Imported {{count}} servers, all off. Check each one, then turn it on.
imp.done_one: Imported {{count}} server, turned off. Check it, then turn it on.
imp.refused.bad_request: The agent refused the import: a name may already be saved there, or an entry is not valid. Nothing was imported.
imp.problem.not_json: This is not a JSON config. Paste the file's JSON as it is, without comments.
imp.problem.reserved: This config carries a field the agent keeps for the names of saved values (env_keys or header_keys). Remove it, then preview again.
imp.block.incomplete: The servers list is not complete right now, so nothing can be imported. Reload, then preview again.
imp.block.otherLayer: {{name}} is also set in {{layer}}. Rename it or remove it there first.
imp.block.case: {{name}} differs only in case from {{existing}}, which is already saved. Use the same spelling to replace it, or another name.
imp.adv.inputs: The config declares inputs Hoody does not ask for. Replace each one with a value before you turn a server on.
imp.adv.env_file: {{name}}: an env file is not read. Move its values into the environment values before you turn it on.
imp.adv.unresolved: {{name}}: a value refers to something the agent cannot fill in, so it would be empty. Replace it before you turn it on.
imp.adv.literal: {{name}}: a ${…} outside environment values or headers is passed as written. Replace it before you turn it on.
imp.adv.other: The agent has more advice about this config that is not shown here. Check each server before you turn it on.
dlg.tools.allLocked: Off: a saved list can't be cleared here yet. Remove the server and add it back.
problem.tools_empty: Type at least one tool name, or choose None of its tools.
problem.tool_name: A tool name has a space or a control character in it, or is longer than 128 characters.
save.toolsOnly: Agents can use only these of its tools: {{names}}.
save.toolsNone: Agents can use none of its tools.
details.title: {{name}} details
details.gone: The latest list no longer has this server. This is what it showed before.
details.offersIdle: {{count}} once it connects, after the tool list
details.offersUnknown: Not known yet: it has not connected
details.stderr: Last lines of its error output
details.noStderr: It has written nothing to its error output.
